prompt: Create a surreal high-fashion studio portrait of two young men with dark curly hair seated back-to-back on the cap of an enormous mushroom, as if it is a stool. Use a vertical 2:3 composition with the mushroom centered in the lower half and the two figures occupying the middle of the frame, leaving a large amount of empty moody background above them. The mushroom has a thick beige stem with natural speckles and an oversized rounded cap, its top covered in faded blue denim-like fabric with a frayed seam around the edge and a tan underside. The left figure wears a dark brown oversized jacket, dark brown button shirt, loose dark trousers, and white low-top sneakers; he sits with legs spread and dangling over the mushroom edge, hands in pockets, looking off to the left with a calm serious expression. The right figure wears a black denim jacket over a black shirt, loose black trousers, and white low-top sneakers; he sits similarly with legs dangling, one hand in pocket, looking off to the right with a composed editorial expression. Use soft cinematic studio lighting from the front-left, gentle shadows, realistic skin texture, sharp fashion photography detail, muted earthy colors, and a dark teal-to-charcoal gradient backdrop with subtle haze. Make the scene photorealistic, editorial, slightly surreal, and minimal, with no text, no logos, and no extra objects.

promptZh: 创作一张超现实的高级时尚摄影棚肖像，画面中两位 留着深色卷发的年轻男子 背靠背坐在一个巨大的蘑菇伞盖上，仿佛将其当作凳子。采用 2:3 的竖构图，蘑菇位于下半部分中心，两位人物占据画面中部，上方留出大量充满情绪感的留白背景。蘑菇拥有粗壮的米色菌柄，带有天然斑点，伞盖硕大圆润，顶部覆盖着褪色的蓝色牛仔布料，边缘有磨损的接缝，底部为棕褐色。左侧人物身穿深棕色廓形夹克、深棕色衬衫、宽松深色长裤和白色低帮运动鞋；他双腿分开悬在蘑菇边缘，双手插兜，神情冷静严肃地看向左侧。右侧人物身穿黑色牛仔夹克内搭黑色衬衫、宽松黑色长裤和白色低帮运动鞋；他以同样的姿势坐着，双腿悬空，单手插兜，神情沉稳地看向右侧。使用来自左前方的柔和电影级摄影棚灯光，营造柔和的阴影，展现真实的皮肤质感、锐利的时尚摄影细节、柔和的大地色调，以及带有轻微雾感的深青色至炭灰色渐变背景。画面需呈现照片级写实、编辑大片感、略带超现实主义且极简的风格，画面中不得包含任何文字、Logo 或多余物体。
